A340E (2JZ-GTE)  AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION  -  COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

39.  REMOVE SECOND BRAKE PISTON SLEEVE

AT5279

40.  REMOVE REAR PLANETARY GEAR AND SECOND
BRAKE
(a)  Using SST and a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.
SST 09350-30020  (09350-07060)

SST

AT5460

(b)  Remove the output shaft.
(c)  Remove the rear planetary gear, second brake and first
and reverse brake pack from the case.

AT5158

(d)  Remove the assembled bearing and race from the first
and reverse brake.

AT5132

(e)  Remove the leaf spirng from the case.

AT5107
